research_question: Can direct chronological-block HJ and alpha robustness stabilize the five-direction learned pricing span?
candidates: group-DRO weighted four-block HJ plus alpha
validation_selection_rule: On 2000-2009 held-out industries, require HJ and mean absolute alpha no worse than both V008 K=5 and FF5 plus momentum; choose lowest held-out-industry alpha, breaking ties by HJ.
development_promotion_rule: On 2010-2019 require at least five-percent HJ and alpha improvements versus FF5 plus momentum on combined assets and held-out industries; require positive HJ and alpha improvements in both 2010-2014 and 2015-2019; factor-span Sharpe must be no lower than FF5 plus momentum.
boundary: Failure ends block-robust refinements of this characteristic-sorted teacher before any five-seed run. Passing still requires a five-seed gate before compression experiments.
